data.gender_notes: Gillman is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'gylle' meaning 'pledge' and 'mann' meaning 'man'. In Anglo-Saxon society, a gillman was a pledged man, a vassal, or a protector. The name Gillman carries the meaning “Pledge, Pledged One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Gillman usually hope their child will grow to embody pledge, pledged one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gillman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
